title: One command confirms a sprint's held answers at its review, horizon lists them, and a confirmed held answer needs no terminal re-confirm
goal: a held answer does not stop its own item's done; the sprint review story's done refuses while a held answer is unconfirmed, naming it held answer to confirm; backlog.py answer SP --confirm-held --by operator confirms every held agent answer of the sprint's items in one call and is refused without --by operator; a confirmation of a held gate from an agent session stores no agent_session flag; horizon lists each sprint's held answers awaiting the operator; test_authority's confirm test gains a planted held gate an agent cannot confirm, within the test ceiling and with no new test id

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t; d=t.mkdtemp(); r=lambda *a: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); n=r("new","sprint","--title","S","--goal","g").stdout.split(); sp,rv=n[2],n[6]; i=r("new","story","--sprint",sp,"--title","T","--goal","g","--touch","AGENTS.md").stdout.split()[2]; r("gate","add",i,"--kind","provisional","--question","Which columns does the table hold?","--option","one table","--option","two tables","--recommendation","one table"); a=r("answer",i,"g1","--provisional"); p=r("done",rv); o=p.stdout+p.stderr; sys.exit(0 if a.returncode==0 and p.returncode!=0 and "held answer to confirm" in o and "Traceback" not in o else "the review does not name the unconfirmed held answer: "+o[-300:])

import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t,os; d=t.mkdtemp(); r=lambda *a, env=None: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env); sp=r("new","sprint","--title","S","--goal","g").stdout.split()[2]; i=r("new","story","--sprint",sp,"--title","T","--goal","g","--touch","AGENTS.md").stdout.split()[2]; r("gate","add",i,"--kind","provisional","--question","Which columns does the table hold?","--option","one table","--option","two tables","--recommendation","one table"); r("answer",i,"g1","--provisional"); h=r("horizon","--sprint",sp); n=r("answer",sp,"--confirm-held"); y=r("answer",sp,"--confirm-held","--by","operator",env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDECODE="1")); v=r("show",i,"--field","gates").stdout; sys.exit(0 if "held" in h.stdout and n.returncode!=0 and y.returncode==0 and "operator" in v and "\"agent_session\"" not in v and "\"agent\"" not in v else "confirm-held, its flag or the horizon list is wrong: "+h.stdout[-200:]+n.stderr[-150:]+y.stdout[-150:]+y.stderr[-150:]+v[-200:])

import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile as t,os; d=t.mkdtemp(); g=lambda *a: s.run(["git","-C",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); g("init","-q"); g("config","user.email","x@example.com"); g("config","user.name","x"); os.makedirs(d+"/skills"); open(d+"/skills/x.md","w").write("x\n"); g("add","."); g("commit","-qm","init"); r=lambda *a: s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",d,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); i=r("new","story","--title","S","--goal","g","--touch","skills/x.md").stdout.split()[2]; r("gate","add",i,"--kind","provisional","--question","Which columns does the table hold?","--option","one table","--option","two tables","--recommendation","one table"); a=r("answer",i,"g1","--provisional"); p=r("done",i); o=p.stdout+p.stderr; sys.exit(0 if a.returncode==0 and "/g1" not in o and "held answer" not in o and "Traceback" not in o else "a held answer stops its own item: "+(a.stdout+a.stderr)[-150:]+o[-300:])

gates.question: When does a held answer reach the operator?
options: At the sprint review: the item lands on the recommendation and a changed answer becomes a redo task
Before its landing: done refuses until the operator confirms
At the review, but landing waits when the touches hold guard code
gates.recommendation: At the sprint review: the item lands on the recommendation and a changed answer becomes a redo task
gates.reason: because it saves about 17 of 44.7 blocked item-hours of the 2026-10-27 drain and only 6 of 257 such gates since 10-15 departed
gates.answer: At the sprint review: the item lands on the recommendation and a changed answer becomes a redo task

gates.question: Does an operator's confirmation of a held answer, recorded from an agent session, carry the agent_session flag for re-confirmation from a terminal?
options: No flag, as for a provisional design answer
Flag it as an operator-class answer

notes: Design, settled at planning 2026-10-28 (gates hold-timing and reconfirm, answered by the operator): held answers reach the operator at the sprint review, not before landing; the review's done names each as held answer to confirm: ID gate G: ANSWER; --confirm-held takes --except ID:GATE (repeatable) for a gate left for its own answer (a changed answer plus a redo task) and --commit for one commit; a refused --confirm-held exits 2 and writes nothing; an answer to a gate that blocks by its own text or a strict signal keeps the agent_session flag as now; horizon prints the count and the list (item, gate, answer), horizon --hook the count; skills/sprint/SKILL.md review step 3 confirms held answers through this command with the reviewer's report beside each; kb/_self/backlog.md and kb/_self/tools.md describe it. Check 2 passes before the work: it pins the critical test the work extends.
